channel.title: Employee Benefit News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Employee Benefit News (benefitnews.com)

item.title: Avoid IRS penalties: How advisers can streamline federal filings
item.description: Handing off clients to an e-filing expert can help reduce administrative strain while allowing HR and benefits teams to focus on employee support and plan strategy.

item.title: AI in healthcare starts long before the exam room
item.description: Navigation-focused AI helps employees identify in-network care, understand coverage and avoid financial surprises — an impact that is immediate and measurable.

item.title: Employers push critical illness plans amid health risks
item.description: As chronic conditions rise nationwide, benefit leaders are urging employees to consider critical illness coverage to offset medical bills and other expenses tied to recovery.

item.title: From child care desert to on-campus school: An employer's solution for working parents
item.description: Healthcare provider Southwest Health is answering a call from the community by building a new facility that will be run by New Horizon Academy.

item.title: Why leaders are putting a renewed focus on PTO policies
item.description: A new report from WTW revealed that leave strategies remain top of mind for organizations looking to recruit and retain.

item.title: Take back control: How employers can regain power over healthcare spending
item.description: Understanding data and contracts, as well as advocating for healthcare partnerships and quality care, can lead to better financial outcomes for businesses.

item.title: Child care surpasses retirement as top work perk
item.description: With rising costs and limited employer support, working parents say reliable child care is critical to productivity, retention and career stability.

item.title: Caregivers find much-needed relief with this unique eldercare solution
item.description: CareYaya matches vetted healthcare students with older adults, providing basic care and peace of mind.

item.title: Why 'flashy' perks won't keep employees at work
item.description: A workplace expert shares how leaders can meet employees' new needs and expectations.

item.title: Building an effective workplace wellness room
item.description: A dedicated space to wellness can combat burnout and improve worker productivity.
